description: Check the GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) score for any existing website. Returns an AI readiness score 0-100, grade A-F, and a breakdown of specific issues that reduce visibility in ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Claude, and other AI search engines. Use this for existing sites. For new or rebuilding sites, use make_site_geo_ready instead. After getting the score, call get_geo_fixes to get specific copy-paste fix instructions.
name: analyze_geo_score
